verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say you can put an AGENTS.md file in your project root (or elsewhere) and Devin reads it before it starts coding. The Knowledge feature is also documented for sharing codebase-level context, so the core story is delivered. Missing for 10: detailed docs on file format and scoping (e.g., nested or per-directory precedence), evidence that the context shapes planning and not just coding, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a context file describing my codebase conventions so agents generate more relevant plans and code

citations.quote: Just put an AGENTS.md file in your project root (or anywhere else). Devin will look for the file before it starts coding.
Knowledge is the best way to share codebase-level (vs. task-level) context that can help Devin when working in your codebase.
